Football green, type only: no photos, no crests.
caption:
Third in May. Sacked in November.

Manchester United sacked Michael Carrick on Thursday after one win from 10 league games, their worst start to a season since 1986, with the club in the relegation zone. Months earlier he had steered them to third.

The replacement: Mauricio Pochettino, who leaves the USA job after taking them to the World Cup last 16. He starts on Nov 18 on a deal reported to run to summer 2029, and becomes United's 8th permanent boss since Sir Alex Ferguson.

His first game? Away at Liverpool on Nov 22.

Is Pochettino the man to fix United, or just the next name on the list? Tell us below.

Details via Sky Sports, RTÉ/PA and Goal.
